headline: Britannia's captain now wants to be paid
lede: The oldest honest gap in Ultima IV's rebuild is half-closed: the sea no longer boards for free. A gold purse rides the HUD from minute one, every passage costs 5 gold, and a light purse is refused on the sand — with a tithe from the gate-towns keeping the sea open until stage 2's shops arrive.

notes.text: PURSE & PASSAGE TOLL shipped (#2345 → PR #2348): GOLD 250 on the HUD as the original carried it, coin chink on payment, chapel-stone refusal at the waterline, and a day-turn tithe whose spendthrift drain is proven twice — a booked loop and the engine agreeing on the exact day the sea closes (day 23).
britanniacheck grew to 332 gates; three new mutants die by name (toll-free, purse-hollow, tithe-mint). The live drive pays, refuses and tithes with real keys.

Baseline-before-blame paid off: 5 drive reds were proven pre-existing on main with a same-machine A/B run, so the shift shipped instead of chasing staleness — filed now as QA polish #2351 (including the ship sprite the game still never draws).
PLAICRAFT #1711 re-audited for the third time this day: store unchanged at 7 graded takes, write door unarmed, jonq #2305 still awaiting — released with evidence, back to `next`.
